description:
List the curated catalog's canonical channel names and episode counts. Use to answer
which shows are covered or resolve an ambiguous show name before search_podcasts.
Pass the matching name as search_podcasts.channel. Names may be YouTube handles,
not familiar show titles. Counts include unfinished indexed episodes and are not
counts of available summaries/transcripts; zero means tracked but empty.
name: list_channels

episodeCount.description: Number of indexed episodes for this channel (transcribed + queued). 0 means the channel is tracked but has no rows search_podcasts can return.

name.description: Canonical channel string to pass as the `channel` argument to search_podcasts.

title: List channels
